title: Film 'Tenzing' Highlights the Sherpa in Historic Everest Summit
seoTitle: Tenzing Puts Sherpa at the Center of History
subtitle: Genden Phuntsok and Tom Hiddleston star as Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary in high-end production
excerpt: In 'Tenzing,' Genden Phuntsok shines as Tenzing Norgay alongside Tom Hiddleston's Edmund Hillary in a recreation of the first Everest ascent in 1953.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The feature film "Tenzing" reconstructs the first ascent to the summit of Mount Everest, placing the Sherpa at the center of the narrative. Genden Phuntsok brings charm and innocence to his portrayal of Tenzing Norgay, while Tom Hiddleston gives a candid turn as Edmund Hillary.

Boasting National Geographic-esque production values, the film showcases soaring mountain vistas and offers a well-intentioned, highly watchable experience, even if it occasionally takes a sanitized tone.

The plot focuses on the historic 1953 expedition, in which Nepali-Indian mountaineer Tenzing Norgay and New Zealander Edmund Hillary reached the pinnacle of Everest achievement.

With information from The Guardian.
